name: Gestao Hospital
description:
Gestao Hospital is a hospital management system that supports the administration of hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood bank resources. The system allows administrators and hospital managers to register, update, delete, and monitor hospitals, while healthcare staff can manage operational information related to patients, appointments, products, and medical resources.

Patients can use the system to search for hospitals, obtain information about specific hospitals, and receive recommendations about the nearest hospital. Hospital staff can register patients, consult patient information and medical history, manage check-in related information, and maintain notes about treatments.

The system also supports hospital logistics by allowing authorized staff to manage products, quantities, requests, and blood samples. Its overall goal is to centralize hospital administration and improve the coordination of clinical and logistical activities.
rawDescription:
Gestao Hospital is a hospital management system that supports the administration of hospitals, patients, beds, products, and blood bank resources. The system allows administrators and hospital managers to register, update, delete, and monitor hospitals, while healthcare staff can manage operational information related to patients, appointments, products, and medical resources.

Patients can use the system to search for hospitals, obtain information about specific hospitals, and receive recommendations about the nearest hospital. Hospital staff can register patients, consult patient information and medical history, manage check-in related information, and maintain notes about treatments.

The system also supports hospital logistics by allowing authorized staff to manage products, quantities, requests, and blood samples. Its overall goal is to centralize hospital administration and improve the coordination of clinical and logistical activities.
highLevelGoals: Provide a unified platform for managing hospital data, resources, and operations to streamline administrative tasks.
Enable hospital managers to monitor real-time data and performance metrics to support decision-making.
Support healthcare staff in managing patient appointments, medical records, and check-in processes efficiently.
Allow patients to search for hospitals and receive location-based recommendations to improve access to care.
Enable hospital staff to register patients, maintain medical notes, and manage check-in information for accurate treatment records.
Allow logistics staff to manage inventory, blood samples, and product requests to ensure clinical and logistical efficiency.
lowLevelGoals: The Administrator registers a new hospital entity into the system with required metadata.
The Administrator configures hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure.
The Hospital Manager accesses a dashboard displaying real-time metrics such as patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization.
The Hospital Manager exports historical operational data for analysis and compliance purposes.
The Healthcare Staff schedules a patient appointment with a specific doctor and time slot.
The Healthcare Staff updates a patient’s medical record with new diagnosis, treatment, or notes.
The Healthcare Staff checks in a patient at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning a room or queue.
The Patient searches for hospitals within a specified geographic area using location-based filters.
The Patient receives personalized hospital recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability.
The Hospital Staff registers a new patient into the system with personal and insurance details.
The Hospital Staff creates a new medical note for a patient, including symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plan.
The Hospital Staff manages patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources.
The Logistics Staff submits a request to replenish medical supplies or equipment in the inventory system.
The Logistics Staff views and updates the status of blood samples in inventory, including expiration and usage.
The Logistics Staff approves or rejects a product request based on availability and clinical need.

baselineCritiques.actors: The actors listed are mostly appropriate for the system's description. However, there is a redundancy between "Healthcare Staff" and "Hospital Staff," as both seem to describe similar roles with overlapping responsibilities (managing patient appointments, medical records, check-in). This duplication should be resolved by merging or clearly distinguishing their roles.
baselineCritiques.highLevelGoals: The high-level goals are well-defined and align with the system's description. All goals are functional and address the core functionalities of the hospital management system, including administration, patient care, logistics, and self-service for patients. No contradictions or omissions were found.
baselineCritiques.lowLevelGoals: The low-level goals are well-aligned with the high-level goals and actors, covering all necessary functional aspects of the hospital management system. There are no contradictions or omissions, and each goal corresponds to a specific action an actor can perform within the software.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Register and configure a new hospital entity in the system, including metadata registration and hospital-specific operational settings configuration.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to register a new hospital entity with required metadata. llg_002 adds the capability to configure hospital-specific settings such as contact info, operating hours, and departmental structure. Together, they form a complete scope for onboarding a hospital into the system with both registration and configuration functionalities.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Manager to monitor real-time operational performance and export historical operational data for analysis and compliance.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Hospital Manager to view real-time operational metrics including patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization, which supports live monitoring. llg_002 enables the Hospital Manager to export historical operational data for analysis and compliance, which supports retrospective review and audit readiness. Together, they cover both real-time monitoring and historical data export without any inferred or generalized functionality.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no unrelated or missing capabilities inferred.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures throughout the patient lifecycle.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing the patient’s identity in the system. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting longitudinal patient care documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in, including identity verification, status updates, and resource assignment, which is a distinct operational phase that occurs before or during clinical encounters. Together, these capabilities cover patient onboarding, clinical documentation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking, and product approval decisions.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 enables initiation of inventory replenishment requests; llg_002 enables real-time tracking and status updates of blood samples including expiration and usage; llg_003 enables decision-making on product requests based on availability and clinical need. These capabilities together define a complete inventory lifecycle management scope for logistics staff, including initiation, monitoring, and approval actions.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Manager to monitor real-time operational performance and export historical operational data for analysis and compliance.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Hospital Manager to view real-time operational metrics including patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization, which supports live monitoring. llg_002 enables the Hospital Manager to export historical operational data for analysis and compliance, which supports retrospective review and audit readiness. Together, they cover both real-time monitoring and historical data export without any inferred or generalized functionality.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues. These three distinct functional capabilities—scheduling, record updating, and check-in—are materially different in action, object, and lifecycle phase, and must all be explicitly included in the reconstructed goal to preserve the full scope.

hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Patients to Search for and Receive Personalized Hospital Recommendations Based on Geographic Proximity, Specialty, and Availability
hlg_046276afce6da8f8_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the Patient to search for hospitals by location, which establishes the geographic filtering capability. llg_002 enables the Patient to receive personalized recommendations based on proximity, specialty, and availability, which adds the decision-support and personalization layer. Together, they form a complete scope of location-based discovery and recommendation, with no hidden or inferred functionality.

hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Hospital Staff to onboard new patients, document clinical information, and manage check-in procedures within the hospital system.
hlg_476ac274557a4b21_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the registration of new patients with personal and insurance details, establishing patient identity and eligibility. llg_002 enables the creation of medical notes containing clinical data such as symptoms, diagnosis, or treatment plans, supporting clinical documentation. llg_003 enables the management of patient check-in by verifying identity, updating status, and assigning resources, which is a distinct operational phase from registration and documentation. Together, these cover patient onboarding, clinical record creation, and check-in management — no capability is generalized or omitted, and the outlier (check-in) is explicitly included to expose its distinct lifecycle phase.

hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Logistics Staff manages medical inventory lifecycle through request initiation, blood sample tracking with expiration and usage updates, and approval/rejection of product requests based on availability and clinical need.
hlg_e6cbeca622c85af3_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to initiate replenishment requests for medical supplies or equipment; llg_002 adds the capability to view and update blood sample status including expiration and usage; llg_003 adds the capability to approve or reject product requests based on availability and clinical need. These three distinct actions together define the complete scope of inventory management by Logistics Staff, including initiation, tracking, and decision-making phases.

hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable full lifecycle management of hospital entities within the system, including registration, configuration, updates, deletion, and real-time operational monitoring.
hlg_eb3bb1fabb8a91b6_001.rationale: llg_001 enables the initial registration of a hospital entity with required metadata; llg_002 allows configuration of hospital-specific settings such as contact info and departmental structure; llg_003 permits modification of existing hospital metadata like address or status; llg_004 supports the removal of a hospital entity and its associated data; llg_005 provides real-time monitoring of operational status, resource availability, and performance metrics. Together, these cover the full lifecycle of a hospital entity from creation to deletion with active monitoring throughout.

hlg_e01285a371937460_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Provide Hospital Manager with real-time visibility into operational metrics, including patient throughput, staff availability, bed utilization, medical product inventory, and blood bank resources with expiration alerts and transfusion requests.
hlg_e01285a371937460_001.rationale: llg_001 adds real-time visibility into patient throughput, staff availability, and resource utilization; llg_002 adds real-time bed occupancy and availability tracking; llg_003 adds real-time monitoring of medical product stock levels and usage trends; llg_004 adds real-time blood bank resource monitoring including sample availability, expiration alerts, and transfusion requests. All four LLGs are distinct in their domain focus (patients, beds, products, blood) and must be explicitly included to preserve the full scope.

hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Healthcare Staff to manage patient appointments, update medical records, and check in patients at the facility, including scheduling, documentation, and facility admission workflows.
hlg_a9ff40162305bff8_001.rationale: llg_001 adds the capability to schedule patient appointments with specific doctors and time slots; llg_002 adds the capability to update patient medical records with diagnoses, treatments, or notes; llg_003 adds the capability to check in patients at the facility, recording arrival time and assigning rooms or queues.
